Controlled HTTP data is fixture data, never claimed as actual Prometheus/Tempo evidence.

No production readiness claim.

failureClassifications.name: Historical Redis refill/capacity
failureClassifications.cause: 500 ms command deadline was captured; exact historical cause not isolated. Complete 89-case suite and every later full run pass. No source defect or exclusive mechanism asserted.

failureClassifications.name: Historical concurrent refund count
failureClassifications.cause: Exact 3-versus-5 assertion reproduced under constrained infrastructure. Two snapshot-preserving selected-case runs and every subsequent full run pass. Underlying historical provider outcome remains unidentified; expectation and provider deadline unchanged.

failureClassifications.name: Historical Search suite hook
failureClassifications.cause: Old JSON retained no initialization exception. Current setup, representative Search operation, two complete Search suites and all 80 integration cases per full run pass; missing old exception is not retroactively reconstructed.

failureClassifications.name: Elasticsearch cold readiness
failureClassifications.cause: Severe Docker VM resource pressure. Same source/image/heap/limits/deadline became ready in 13.137 seconds after user freed unrelated workloads, versus repeated 900-second timeouts before. Later independent preflights also passed; no OOM/quota configuration defect demonstrated.

failureClassifications.name: Live proof missing advisor-error series
failureClassifications.cause: Fixture required a populated provider-error panel but never exercised an advisor failure. Added a controlled local provider failure through the real advisor, using an actual observed query candidate; no direct metric injection.

failureClassifications.name: Advisor early-import metric loss
failureClassifications.cause: Phase 19 advisor created metric instruments before SDK initialization. In-process early imports permanently retained no-op instruments, leaving the advisor-error dashboard panel empty.
